about: 青花 first look, the modern set: a dish in Met 18.61.2's form with that plate's pattern (borrowed, CC0) under the museum's flat light, seen from 35 degrees up (materials/qinghua/dish.py)

camera.why: our choice: oblique (35 degrees up, from the photo's bottom edge), so the well, the cavetto and the lip read and the glaze shows its highlights; 840 mm with a 100 mm lens puts the dish across about 60% of the width ('fill' frames by the height, which for a dish is its 38 mm)

expose.why: our choice: the lit white glaze near 3/4 of full scale
